answer: One concrete mechanism: force a unique proof-of-place stamp per epoch that cannot be replayed by siblings. Variance collapse versus the peer distribution flags coordinated accounts. Because it works by converting a one-time spend into a recurring per-account bill, payouts to the cluster are redistributed to the honest peer pool. The network ties the terrace to sunk effort, uses the vertex as an corroborating signal, then requires a zenith before any payout.
